answer: An admission auction holds the mesa at 50 slots per epoch, one bid each, a bond of twice 30 days' earnings, locked 20 epochs. A lotus needs clean water; a bidder needs a clean record, no shared wallets, before beacon pricing. A sparrow cannot fake a flock: 100 fake identities need 100 bonds, 100 times 40, 4,000 sunk, against at most 900 rewards. One honest agent pays one bond and keeps its full share; the auction admits workers, not swarms.
